provenance.source: Full reference extraction, editorial common names, Wikimedia complete monthly human pageviews
provenance.scopeNote: Mountains, ranges, peaks and volcanoes in the full GeoNames reference; one answer per name.
provenance.qualityFilter: All cleaned GeoNames names retained. Wikipedia descriptions qualify readership only; absent or unrelated articles leave obscurity unknown. No result-count cap.
provenance.ranking: Complete October 2026 human pageviews, all access methods, divided by 31 days; absent data remains unknown
